dict.Facturile emise și cât s-a încasat din f: The invoices issued and how much has been collected on each: the balance still to collect is split automatically by how late it is (not yet due, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90 and over 90 days), with the old amounts in yellow and red; on the right the total for each group, its share of the total and the longest delay.
dict.Facturile încasate complet nu mai apar î: Invoices collected in full no longer appear in the ageing columns.
dict.Pentru întârzierile mari trimite o notif: For long delays send a notice (Docs → Payment notice) or offer a payment plan.
dict.Scrie fiecare factură emisă și cât s-a î: Enter each invoice issued and how much has been collected on it: the balance goes into the right ageing column by itself.
